needs.what: The frame rate the game was tested at is not applied (nxnative writes the engine's frame limit or steps the game by the host's vsyncs); the game runs at its own rate.
Conditional rendering (SetRenderEnableConditional) is not evaluated: some clears or draws may be wrong.

nxnative gives this game a 8.00 GB heap region (nxweb: 1.50 GB) and a 4.00 GB alias region (nxweb: 1.87 GB); a game that sizes its heap from the memory pool it is told about will ask for more than a 4 GB WebAssembly memory can map (the pool nxweb reports would have to be smaller; not tried).

names: frame interval from the host's step
